title: An Artist Adrift
description: You find an artist from Fontaine in distress in a cave by the water...

mainQuestExcel.title: An Artist Adrift
mainQuestExcel.description: You find an artist from Fontaine in distress in a cave by the water...

flow.stepDescription: Speak to the person who has fallen on the ground

dialogs.text: Ugh...
#Looks like this guy's not doing so good... He must be famished! Let's give him some of our food, shall we, {NICKNAME}?
May this food give him strength.
Not to be biased or anything, but Paimon thinks you make great food!
You give the collapsed man some Teyvat Fried Egg.
I... I live! I live again!
Whoa, he must really have been starving. That was just one fried egg...
Ah, that unspeakable deliciousness was enough to revive the dead, surely! If I had known that fried eggs could taste this glorious, I would've bought that mysterious egg off that fellow.
What mysterious egg?
It is said that eating the egg can help you deflect a day's worth of misfortune. Oh, how I wish I'd bought one... or perhaps even twelve...
Uh, that sounds really suspicious — and Paimon reckons she knows a scam when she sees one. Still, how did you end up here?
I... Well, I'm a renowned artist from Fontaine, and I'm here in Sumeru to gather inspiration for my work. Call me Julien.
Inspiration? Here?
Yeah. Aren't there more suitable places for gathering inspiration? Y'know, someplace with a better view and better safety measures?
Also, if you're an artist from Fontaine, why are you empty-handed? ... You're actually a Fatui mole, aren't you?
Such radical reasoning! So radical, in fact, that one wonders what experiences may have led you to even have such thoughts! However, I am an artist, and nothing but that, I fear.
It's just that... Well, I had already gained enough inspiration here and was preparing to return to Fontaine with what I'd gained.

I never expected that Sumeru's weather could be so dry. When I passed through Chenyu Vale on my way here, the air still felt relatively humid, but the sandstorms started picking up the moment I stepped into Sumeru's bounds...
I must confess that I'm better suited to wetter climates, so I was planning to travel back by water to experience different scenery, but my raft was washed away, and I'm not a swimmer, so...
I imagine you must have had a hard time living in Fontaine.

That is the case, though it is not merely a matter of being a swimmer or not... *sigh* Never mind. I did find a place to rest by the water and there are still some tea leaves that have yet to become completely sodden. Allow me to thank you...
By inviting us to have some tea?
Oh, of course, of course! I shall have to express my gratitude for the gift of the fried egg, indeed. How should I address the two of you?
Ah, right, Paimon almost forgot about introductions!
#We're {NICKNAME} and Paimon.
Ah, such brilliant names. Well, whatever the case, come and have some tea. My camp is nearby. In fact, we're almost there.
#The envoy of justice and {M#his}{F#her} attendant.
#We're {NICKNAME} and Paimon — the awesomest companion!
Call us Shining Gold and Silver Glimmer.
#We're the Shining Gold {NICKNAME}, and the Silver Glimmering Paimon!
Does anyone even call themselves a "renowned" anything?
Exactly!
Well, he's not you.
C'mon! Everyone's definitely fainted from hunger at least once in their lives, right?

flow.stepDescription: Return with Julien to his camp

dialogs.text: What a simple camp... Paimon wonders if you could even call it a camp.
Well, the scenery here is quite good, and there's a sense of openness whenever I stand by the water. It's honestly a lot more relaxing than when I was in Fontaine.
What sort of life did you lead while you were there, seriously? That's... not quite what Paimon was expecting from a renowned artist.
I lived in a very small place back in Fontaine... And um, that's only because I'm a humble person.
But even outdoor adventurer camps look way better than this. Huh? You have an animal buddy?
Um, I don't have one. This must've been left behind by an adventurer or something like that. Speaking of which...
I would love to receive you in better fashion, but most of my luggage fell into the water when my raft fell apart, and I cannot swim...
But if you could find my lost luggage for me...
Would it even be usable after getting soaked like that...
I did carefully pack everything up, but there are some things that... *sigh* Well, if I've lost them, I've lost them. I can always redraw them... yes, redraw them...
Um, perhaps we should help out. This guy seems like he's in a real bad spot.
I have no one else to rely on here, so I can only ask the two of you for aid. I'll be waiting here with some good tea in hand.
I'm counting on you regarding my luggage...

flow.stepDescription: Look for Julien's luggage in the water
Look for Julien's luggage in the water
Look for Julien's luggage on the beach

dialogs.text: I'm counting on you regarding my luggage...

flow.stepDescription: Check on the dog on the beach

dialogs.text: I'm counting on you regarding my luggage...
Strange. Why would there be a dog here? And it seems to be guarding something, too.
(Watches you warily.)
Smart doggie.
(Gives a short bark.)
Right, didn't we see a food bowl back at Julien's camp? Maybe it belongs to this fella! Strange, though. Didn't Julien say that he didn't have any animal companions?
*whimpers*
The dog runs toward the camp...
It's gone... Let's ask Julien about this later. For now, though... Paimon wonders what's under this sand pile. Should we take a look?
Where did this wild dog come from, anyway...
(Gives a low growl.)
I'm counting on you regarding my luggage...
I'm counting on you regarding my luggage...

flow.stepDescription: Go to the camp and talk to Julien

dialogs.text: We're back! Huh, so it is your animal companion, Julien!
(Lets out a threatening growl.)
Wonderful, Pepper... Taken to growling at me, have you? Don't you know who's keeping us both fed here?
(Oh, so it has a name! But on the other hand... is this guy seriously arguing with a dog?)
(They seem to be really close.)
(Is that what "close" looks like to you!?)
Hey, Julien! We found the stuff you lost! Pepper's your animal buddy, isn't it? Why did you lie to us earlier?
If this ungrateful fellow counts as my buddy... I'd rather adopt a Rifthound.
I doubt that you'll be companions for very long...
Exactly. If someone like you, who faints from hunger, ran into a Rifthound, the resulting problem wouldn't be one we could solve with just a Teyvat Fried Egg...
Speaking of which, it seems to have been guarding a drawing board on the beach.
It might have wanted to hide it...
Bad doggie!
(Barks, seemingly in protest.)
Are you seriously whining about this? If I hadn't followed you into this corner, I could've returned to Fontaine via my original path...
Eh? Didn't you say that you ended up taking the waterways because you wanted to see the sights there?

Okay, fine... The truth is, I didn't even get to enjoy Sumeru's scenery — I just followed the dog and ended up in this place. The roads here point in all directions, so it was impossible to not get lost...
Oh, so that's how it was. C'mon, you should have just told us the truth from the start! Why didn't you?
Um... To... preserve the image of a renowned artist?
Ugh, you sound like you're just trying to fake us out when you stammer like that, and you're not very good at it either!
#But speaking of scenery here in Sumeru, {NICKNAME} and Paimon do happen to know some good spots. We can take you there.
N—No need. Um, I mean... thanks for your offer, but I am a renowned artist, after all. Ultimately, I believe that worthwhile sceneries must be ones that we discover ourselves...
Oh, and the tea's ready. Do you also happen to have more fried eggs? You know, as a little snack to go with the tea...
What an unusual combo.
#Exactly! {NICKNAME}'s a master of many dishes! We can always have something else instead, hehe.
You enjoy the tea together with some snacks.\nThe tea's taste is hard to describe...
Um, this tea...
A friend of mine sold it to me. Apparently, it can activate the potential wisdom within you. I think it tastes great.
I'm glad I don't have any friends like that.
How come? Having friends is a good thing. In fact, I came to Sumeru on a friend's recommendation as well.
Thank you both for what you've done for me today. I hope the compensation I prepared meets your expectations...
It's fine, it's just... You sure you don't need our help in gathering inspiration? Paimon feels like you might get lost.
The point of a pilgrimage... I mean, the point of a journey lies in walking it by oneself. I shouldn't trouble you two any further. I will undertake this myself.
Well, sure, if you say so. Make sure you don't faint from hunger on the road again!
Could you give me another cup?
#You sure there's nothing wrong with your taste buds, {NICKNAME}?
Haha, not to be stingy or anything, but I'll still be in Sumeru for a while, so I need to save some for myself.
That sounds like wishful thinking to me.
Hmm... But tea alone feels like it's missing something, you know? Let's just whip something up.
It might have been protecting the drawing board from being stolen.
But it ran off the moment we found it!
(I don't smell any wine...)
(Is he just usually like that? Seems like a rather troublesome guy...)
